dataset_name.description: The name of the dataset being used from the source. This typically matches the 'dataset' value found in a record's sources column.

inception_date.description: The first date this source was used in the given Overture theme, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

source.description: Information about where the data comes from, including URLs and downloads.

data_location.description: Landing page or portal URLs where data is described.

data_download.description: Direct download link(s) to the data.

license.description: License information for the source data.

type.description: The license that data from this source falls under (e.g. CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, Open Data License).

text.description: Relevant license text, direct from the license URL.

attribution.description: Attribution text required by this source.

areas.description: List of covered administrative areas (ISO 3166-1 country code in iso_3166_1, optional ISO 3166-2 codes in iso_3166_2).

iso_3166_2.description: Optional list of ISO 3166-2 codes within the country.

description.description: A description of the coverage type of the source data - i.e. national, regional, local.

bbox.description: The bounding box of this source's coverage in [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] order.

file_information.description: File and path details for the sourced data.

oa_path.description: File path and name in OpenAddresses, if applicable (addresses theme only).

data_layer_name.description: Name of the data layer used from this source.

file_format.description: Format of the file used from this source.

address_levels.description: Available address level attributes from OpenAddress, if applicable (addresses theme only).

refresh_schedule.description: How and when the source is refreshed in the Overture pipeline.

frequency.description: How frequently the source data is updated.

source.description: The ingest source path for data (e.g., 'OpenAddresses' or 'tf-data-platform').

type.description: Whether the data is continuously updated or needs manual intervention.

month.description: The month (or months, numeric) in which the data is updated for Overture releases.

known_issues.description: A description of any issues with the data that are known - i.e. data is incomplete, records are incomplete, coverage is incomplete, etc.

notes.description: Freeform notes about this data source, including notes on any pre-processing requirements.

license_priority.description: A map of license type to numeric priority (lower is preferred) for conflation when multiple sources exist.
